requirements: Single owning event-loop thread; external cross-thread marshaling is caller-owned.
Callbacks never invoke sink, engine, control plane, filesystem, network, backtesting or LLM.

Sink failure/cancellation retains head; downstream must deduplicate event IDs for at-least-once retry.
This is nonauthoritative market fan-out, never a durable admission/command queue.

Supervisor may replace only output.sandbox with the final measured SandboxReceipt after workload termination, not economics, lineage or evidence.
Adapter never synthesizes limits_enforced/network/execution flags or claims OS isolation; actual host implementation remains separately required.
Native public input validation, canonical artifact equality, dataset content hashes, event lineage/order/deduplication/byte and declared-event bounds remain checked.
Research planner retains public evidence validation, causal/scientific qualification and acceptance; source-defined adapter is not proof of economic realism.
Integration owner supplies services/research package path; no research-owned source was edited.
